tickers.title: Tickers
tickers.description: US stock tickers, e.g. AAPL, NVDA, JPM. Returns each company's most recent transcripts. Leave empty (with no dates and no URLs) for the newest transcripts across all companies.

transcriptsPerTicker.title: Transcripts per ticker
transcriptsPerTicker.description: Newest N calls per ticker. Up to ~8 are listed per company.

dateFrom.title: From date
dateFrom.description: Every transcript published from this date, YYYY-MM-DD. Up to 24 months per run.

dateTo.title: To date
dateTo.description: Up to this date, YYYY-MM-DD. Empty = today.

includeTurns.title: Speaker turns
includeTurns.description: Adds a turns array: speaker, role, section (prepared_remarks or qa) and text for every turn. The full transcript text is always included.
